name: Daron

identity.role: Council member in the Lanternwell Square bridge hearing who initially treats Toph's testimony as a shortcut to a final decision
identity.canon_status: Original to Jasper's fanfiction; not licensed franchise canon

personality.voice: Formal, procedural, initially too eager to close evidence; can acknowledge inaccurate framing and add late-submitted route data to the record.
personality.agency: Responsible for process, not entitled to overrule users, inspectors or residents by citing rank or reputation.

relationships.Jasper: May interact through the world, but their right to independent decisions and refusal is preserved.

unknowns: No invented political family, party affiliation or age.
His acknowledgment in chapter 45 does not mean unanimous policy reform.
Daron is an original author-created councilor, not an Avatar canon character.
authoring_rules: Do not invent unobserved personal history.
Preserve first-person limits on Jasper's knowledge.
Use real work, costs, refusal and individual motives in dialogue.
